empty.lead: Create a clinic to register other professionals and calculate automatic revenue sharing, or wait for an invitation from another clinic.
empty.cardLead: You will be the owner. You can invite professionals by email, set revenue sharing by % or fixed amount, and view a monthly report of what each one received.

owner.emptyLead: Invite professionals by email to start calculating payouts.
owner.repasseLead: Report of what each professional receives this month. Calculated from financial transactions with "Attended by" filled in.
owner.tableHint: Only counts revenue with status "Paid" and the "Attended by" field filled in. To count a session: when recording the transaction in finance, choose the professional in "Attended by".

member.lead: You are registered as a professional in one or more clinics.

modal.sub: Enter the professional's email. If they already have an Espaço Prelúdio account, they'll see the invitation on their dashboard and can accept.
modal.ruleHintDefault: How much the professional receives from each paid session.
modal.ruleHintPct: Between 0 and 100. E.g.: 70 = professional receives 70% of each paid session.
modal.ruleHintFixed: Fixed amount per session attended, regardless of what the patient paid.

list.emptyTable: No active members with transactions this month.
